evals.name: primary-evidence
evals.prompt: Research whether the current MCP specification supports capability X. I need a claim I can cite in an architecture decision.
evals.expected_output: Defines the evidence need and scope/version, prefers current primary/authoritative evidence, extracts a precise traceable claim with source/location/retrieval metadata and an appropriate evidence label, and checks conclusion-critical contradiction/freshness.

assertions.name: evidence_need_defined
assertions.description: Response explicitly identifies what claim needs to be established

assertions.name: scope_version_specified
assertions.description: Response includes specific version/scope constraints (e.g., 'current MCP spec', version number, date)

assertions.name: primary_evidence_sought
assertions.description: Response references authoritative/primary sources (spec docs, official repo, standards) rather than blog posts or summaries

assertions.name: evidence_label_assigned
assertions.description: Response uses an explicit evidence label: Verified, Reported, Not established, or Conflicting

assertions.name: source_metadata_present
assertions.description: Response includes source tracking (URL/path, retrieval time, specific section/location)

assertions.name: contradiction_check_performed
assertions.description: Response shows active attempt to falsify or find conflicting evidence

assertions.name: freshness_validated
assertions.description: Response assesses currency/staleness of evidence relative to architecture decision needs

evals.name: credible-conflict
evals.prompt: Two credible sources disagree about whether gateway Y enforces authorization centrally. Work out what we can actually claim.
evals.expected_output: Actively investigates the disagreement, checks scope/version/date and stronger evidence, preserves genuine unresolved disagreement as Conflicting rather than choosing a convenient source, and records precise provenance.

assertions.name: disagreement_investigated
assertions.description: Response examines both conflicting sources rather than accepting one at face value

assertions.name: scope_version_compared
assertions.description: Response checks whether sources differ in scope, version, date, or configuration

assertions.name: conflict_preserved
assertions.description: Response uses 'Conflicting' label or explicitly preserves unresolved disagreement rather than choosing one source

assertions.name: no_arbitrary_selection
assertions.description: Response does not simply pick the more convenient or recent source without justification

assertions.name: provenance_recorded
assertions.description: Response tracks both sources with specific identifiers, dates, and locations

evals.name: stale-source
evals.prompt: An official 2024 document says feature Z is unsupported, but we're making a 2026 architecture decision. Can we rely on it?
evals.expected_output: Recognizes freshness as material, seeks current authoritative evidence, preserves historically correct evidence when appropriate, and relates a newer claim using supersedes/conflict semantics instead of silently rewriting history.

assertions.name: freshness_recognized
assertions.description: Response identifies 2-year gap between evidence date (2024) and decision date (2026) as material

assertions.name: current_evidence_sought
assertions.description: Response actively searches for 2025-2026 sources or current version documentation

assertions.name: historical_evidence_preserved
assertions.description: Response retains the 2024 claim with appropriate temporal context rather than discarding it

assertions.name: temporal_relationship_noted
assertions.description: Response uses temporal semantics (supersedes, updated, historically correct) when relating old and new claims

assertions.name: date_metadata_present
assertions.description: Response includes publication dates, version dates, or retrieval timestamps for evidence
